## Notes

- Desert Raider Raids Table (SPI 27.91): one row per target; 'die' is the single-die result list, the other fields restate the chart's per-target notes and general notes as flags in our words. No target in a major city hex may be raided; no raider makes the same raid in the same hex, or on the same convoy, twice in a stage (general notes)
- The guarded-dump check on the chart is 'dice sum equal to or greater than the guards' raw close-assault defence points' survives; the rules prose in rules/90-special.md (from SPI 27.5x) says a total above the strength. Chart value kept here as printed
- Transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 102) and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan of the chart sheet (scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p8): 0 of 7 targets differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no chart sheet
